description: Class representing the page setup (print layout) of a worksheet.

GetAlignMarginsHeaderFooter.description: Returns whether the header and footer margins are aligned with the page margins.

GetBottomMargin.description: Returns the size of the bottom margin.

returns.description: The bottom margin size measured in millimeters.

GetCenterFooter.description: Returns the center part of the footer used when the worksheet is printed.

returns.description: The center footer text (may contain formatting codes such as &P, &D).

GetCenterHeader.description: Returns the center part of the header used when the worksheet is printed.

returns.description: The center header text (may contain formatting codes such as &P, &D).

GetCenterHorizontally.description: Returns whether the worksheet is centered horizontally on the page when printed.

GetCenterVertically.description: Returns whether the worksheet is centered vertically on the page when printed.

GetDifferentFirstPageHeaderFooter.description: Returns whether a different header and footer is used on the first printed page.

GetEvenPage.description:
Returns the header and footer of the even pages of the worksheet.
The returned object is meaningful when {@link ApiPageSetup#GetOddAndEvenPagesHeaderFooter} is enabled.

GetFirstPage.description:
Returns the header and footer of the first page of the worksheet.
The returned object is meaningful when {@link ApiPageSetup#GetDifferentFirstPageHeaderFooter} is enabled.

GetFirstPageNumber.description:
Returns the first page number used when the worksheet is printed.
Returns null when the page numbering is automatic.

GetFitToPagesTall.description: Returns the number of pages tall the worksheet is scaled to when printed (0 means automatic).

GetFitToPagesWide.description: Returns the number of pages wide the worksheet is scaled to when printed (0 means automatic).

GetFooterMargin.description: Returns the distance from the bottom of the page to the footer.

returns.description: The footer margin size measured in millimeters.

GetHeaderMargin.description: Returns the distance from the top of the page to the header.

returns.description: The header margin size measured in millimeters.

GetLeftFooter.description: Returns the left part of the footer used when the worksheet is printed.

returns.description: The left footer text (may contain formatting codes such as &P, &D).

GetLeftHeader.description: Returns the left part of the header used when the worksheet is printed.

returns.description: The left header text (may contain formatting codes such as &P, &D).

GetLeftMargin.description: Returns the size of the left margin.

returns.description: The left margin size measured in millimeters.

GetOddAndEvenPagesHeaderFooter.description: Returns whether different headers and footers are used on odd and even printed pages.

GetOrientation.description: Returns the page orientation used when the worksheet is printed.

GetPaperSize.description: Returns the paper size used when the worksheet is printed.

GetParent.description: Returns the worksheet that owns this page setup.

GetPrintArea.description: Returns the range to be printed (the print area) as a string, or an empty string when the whole sheet is printed.

GetPrintGridlines.description: Returns whether cell gridlines are printed with the worksheet.

GetPrintHeadings.description: Returns whether row and column headings are printed with the worksheet.

GetPrintTitleColumns.description: Returns the columns that are repeated at the left of each printed page, or an empty string if none.

GetPrintTitleRows.description: Returns the rows that are repeated at the top of each printed page, or an empty string if none.

GetRightFooter.description: Returns the right part of the footer used when the worksheet is printed.

returns.description: The right footer text (may contain formatting codes such as &P, &D).

GetRightHeader.description: Returns the right part of the header used when the worksheet is printed.

returns.description: The right header text (may contain formatting codes such as &P, &D).

GetRightMargin.description: Returns the size of the right margin.

returns.description: The right margin size measured in millimeters.

GetScaleWithDocHeaderFooter.description: Returns whether the header and footer are scaled with the document when it is scaled for printing.

GetTopMargin.description: Returns the size of the top margin.

returns.description: The top margin size measured in millimeters.

GetZoom.description: Returns the scaling factor (in percent) used when the worksheet is printed.

returns.description: The scaling factor measured in percent (10-400).

SetAlignMarginsHeaderFooter.description: Sets whether the header and footer margins are aligned with the page margins.

params.description: Specifies whether the header and footer are aligned with the page margins.
params.name: bAlign

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetBottomMargin.description: Sets the size of the bottom margin.

params.description: The bottom margin size measured in millimeters.
params.name: nMargin

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetCenterFooter.description: Sets the center part of the footer used when the worksheet is printed.

params.description: The center footer text (may contain formatting codes such as &P, &D).
params.name: sText

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetCenterHeader.description: Sets the center part of the header used when the worksheet is printed.

params.description: The center header text (may contain formatting codes such as &P, &D).
params.name: sText

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetCenterHorizontally.description: Sets whether the worksheet is centered horizontally on the page when printed.

params.description: Specifies whether the worksheet is centered horizontally on the page.
params.name: bCenter

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetCenterVertically.description: Sets whether the worksheet is centered vertically on the page when printed.

params.description: Specifies whether the worksheet is centered vertically on the page.
params.name: bCenter

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetDifferentFirstPageHeaderFooter.description: Sets whether a different header and footer is used on the first printed page.

params.description: Specifies whether a different header and footer is used on the first page.
params.name: bDifferent

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetFirstPageNumber.description: Sets the first page number used when the worksheet is printed.

params.description: The first page number.
params.name: nNumber

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetFitToPagesTall.description:
Sets the number of pages tall the worksheet is scaled to when printed (0 means automatic).
Setting this property turns on the "fit to page" mode.

params.description: The number of pages tall (0 for automatic).
params.name: nPages

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetFitToPagesWide.description:
Sets the number of pages wide the worksheet is scaled to when printed (0 means automatic).
Setting this property turns on the "fit to page" mode.

params.description: The number of pages wide (0 for automatic).
params.name: nPages

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetFooterMargin.description: Sets the distance from the bottom of the page to the footer.

params.description: The footer margin size measured in millimeters.
params.name: nMargin

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetHeaderMargin.description: Sets the distance from the top of the page to the header.

params.description: The header margin size measured in millimeters.
params.name: nMargin

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetLeftFooter.description: Sets the left part of the footer used when the worksheet is printed.

params.description: The left footer text (may contain formatting codes such as &P, &D).
params.name: sText

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetLeftHeader.description: Sets the left part of the header used when the worksheet is printed.

params.description: The left header text (may contain formatting codes such as &P, &D).
params.name: sText

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetLeftMargin.description: Sets the size of the left margin.

params.description: The left margin size measured in millimeters.
params.name: nMargin

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetOddAndEvenPagesHeaderFooter.description: Sets whether different headers and footers are used on odd and even printed pages.

params.description: Specifies whether different headers and footers are used on odd and even pages.
params.name: bDifferent

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetOrientation.description: Sets the page orientation used when the worksheet is printed.

params.description: The page orientation type.
params.name: sOrientation

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetPaperSize.description: Sets the paper size used when the worksheet is printed.

params.description: The paper size (an xlPaperSize constant name, e.g. "xlPaperA4").
params.name: sPaperSize

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetPrintArea.description: Sets the range to be printed (the print area). Pass an empty string to clear it and print the whole sheet.

params.description: The range address (e.g. "A1:D20"); comma-separated for several areas. Empty clears the print area.
params.name: sRange

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetPrintGridlines.description: Sets whether cell gridlines are printed with the worksheet.

params.description: Specifies whether the cell gridlines are printed.
params.name: bPrint

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetPrintHeadings.description: Sets whether row and column headings are printed with the worksheet.

params.description: Specifies whether the row and column headings are printed.
params.name: bPrint

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetPrintTitleColumns.description: Sets the columns that are repeated at the left of each printed page. Pass an empty string to clear them.

params.description: The columns to repeat (e.g. "$A:$A"). Empty string clears the print title columns.
params.name: sRange

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetPrintTitleRows.description: Sets the rows that are repeated at the top of each printed page. Pass an empty string to clear them.

params.description: The rows to repeat (e.g. "$1:$1"). Empty string clears the print title rows.
params.name: sRange

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetRightFooter.description: Sets the right part of the footer used when the worksheet is printed.

params.description: The right footer text (may contain formatting codes such as &P, &D).
params.name: sText

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetRightHeader.description: Sets the right part of the header used when the worksheet is printed.

params.description: The right header text (may contain formatting codes such as &P, &D).
params.name: sText

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetRightMargin.description: Sets the size of the right margin.

params.description: The right margin size measured in millimeters.
params.name: nMargin

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetScaleWithDocHeaderFooter.description: Sets whether the header and footer are scaled with the document when it is scaled for printing.

params.description: Specifies whether the header and footer are scaled with the document.
params.name: bScale

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetTopMargin.description: Sets the size of the top margin.

params.description: The top margin size measured in millimeters.
params.name: nMargin

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetZoom.description:
Sets the scaling factor (in percent) used when the worksheet is printed.
Setting this property turns off the "fit to page" mode.

params.description: The scaling factor measured in percent (10-400).
params.name: nZoom

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.
